sources.reason: complete-official-docs-apikey-json-api: the entire API surface (60 IWebmasterApi methods) is enumerated authoritatively in Microsoft Learn docs; a hand-authored internal YAML spec covers 100% of endpoints. Target is an api-key-authenticated JSON web service (ssl.bing.com/webmaster/api.svc), not a sniffable website. No bot-protection, no client-rendering, no missing-endpoint gap — browser-sniff cannot surface anything the documented public JSON API does not already define.
